description: Vulnerability scanner for packages, CVE lookup (OSV), dependency security check. Known security vulnerabilities for an open-source package, optionally at a specific version, from the OSV.dev database (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist...): ID, CVE aliases, summary, severity, published date and fixed versions. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: vulnerabilities
